posts.cooked:
We’re happy to announce that Horizons of Spirit Island will be available on June 29th on all platforms.

This new DLC will retail for $8.99 USD. Wishlist it on Steam here: Spirit Island - Horizons of Spirit Island on Steam

On mobile, players can purchase Horizons of Spirit Island as an In App Purchase, either instead of or in addition to the core game experience. Alternatively on mobile, Horizons of Spirit Island will be included for all players with the All Access Subscription.

As usual, happy to answer any questions!
